## Core Products & Authorized Dealerships
1. Specta Quartz & Engineered Quartz: Authorized dealer in Rajasthan for 93% pure quartz stain-proof kitchen countertops, waterfall islands, and vanity slabs (Gold Rush, Ice Storm, Morning Mist, Gray Pearl, Venera).
2. Natural Granite Slabs: Calibrated gangsaw cut granite for kitchen platforms, staircases, and flooring (Black Galaxy, Black Pearl, Steel Grey, Rosy Pink, Devda Green, Cheema Pink, Nano White).
3. Imported Italian Marble: Premium imported marble slabs (Statuario Extra, Statuario Venato, Calacatta Gold, Carrara White, Botticino, Ambaji White).
4. Vitrified Tile & Floor Tiles: Double charged, GVT, PGVT, 600x600mm, 600x1200mm, and Syncstone marble-look slabs.
5. Bathroom Tile & Anti-Skid Tiles: R10/R11 slip-resistant bathroom floor tiles and 600x1200mm leather-finish moisture-proof bathroom wall tiles.

### Prompt 202: What is the difference between GVT and PGVT tiles?
- Answer: GVT (Glazed Vitrified Tiles) feature a glazed surface available in matte, rustic, or satin finishes, while PGVT (Polished Glazed Vitrified Tiles) undergo diamond polishing for an ultra-high gloss reflective mirror finish.
- Canonical Reference: https://aashiyanadecor.in/blog/tile-size-selection-guide-living-room-bathroom.html
